text:
marta_pm: Brain dump: new proposal — "staged-commit". Instead of a single committed burst pool, customers buy a base tranche + one or more peak tranches that unlock based on traffic signals. Idea is to give predictability for baseline while letting customers buy cheap, on-demand peak tranches that are cheaper than pure overage but cheaper than full reserve. Want product + infra input.

leo_eng: interesting. How do tranches unlock? are they time-based or signal-based?

marta_pm: two modes: (1) schedule-based: tranche active for defined windows (e.g., marketing campaign hours); (2) signal-based: tranche unlock when customer's 5m p95 against baseline exceeds threshold T for N consecutive windows.

anya_research: can we tie unlock signal to model-quality checks? e.g., only allow peak tranche for routes that pass latency/quality gating so we don't subsidize noisy traffic.

leo_eng: implementation sketch: admission layer has per-tenant state: baseline_quota, tranche_list [{id, capacity, unlock_mode, cooldown}]. Router evaluates requests against baseline first, then hot tranches; tranches have TTL and cooldown to avoid oscillation. If global pressure, tranches are revocable in priority order.

dina_ops: ops concerns: must expose tranche burn rate metrics, preempt events, and a global circuit to stop all tranches if cross-pool utilization bad. Also need a way to mark certain routes as tranche-ineligible.

paul_sales: from GTM: customers like predictability and simplicity. We should present 3 product SKUs: Starter (base only), Seasonal (base + one scheduled tranche), Dynamic (base + signal tranches + rebalancing). Include sample pricing.

kevin_sre: preemption semantics? if a tranche is revoked mid-request, what's expected? We can't silently drop tokens. Either allow request to finish from baseline reserve or fail the request. Need a graceful fallback policy.

leo_eng: technical approach: stash per-request KV of 'consumed_tranche_tokens'. On preempt, router marks future requests as denied to tranche but lets in-flight complete if less than grace_tokens threshold. We'll need preempt_grace_tokens and preempt_mode: finish|reject-new.

marta_pm: pricing thought: tranche subscription has a fixed monthly allocation + per-token usage within tranche at discounted overage rate. Example: base 1M tokens/mo; seasonal tranche 500k tokens reserved during window at 50% of overage rate; dynamic tranche price higher but lower than on-demand.

anya_research: QA: add synthetic traffic scenarios: ramp spike, oscillation, false positives (e.g., test traffic), cross-route bleed. Create eval set that simulates tranche unlock and preemption and watch generation quality.

paul_sales: packaging: pilot 1 = Seasonal with simple UI for schedule windows. Pilot 2 = Dynamic with ops-assisted onboarding and 2-week trial. Legal will want clear eviction language.

dina_ops: runbook: alert when tranche_preempt_rate > 2% for 10m OR tranche_fail_rate > 1% for 5m. Also dashboard panels: per-tranche burn, time-to-unlock, average latency delta during tranche.

kevin_sre: add kill switches: global_tranche_disable, region_tranche_disable, pool_tranche_disable. Make them a single-bit flag evaluable at router hotpath.

leo_eng: effort: router changes (admission + state) + console UX + billing mapping + telemetry + runbook. Roughly 3 teams x 3 sprints. Needs careful perf testing for per-tenant state in hotpath.

marta_pm: open questions: how to handle multi-tenant pools where tranches overlap? proposal: tranches are tenant-scoped; if multiple tenants spike, global soft-eviction kicks in. Consider priority_score and fair-share among active tranches.

anya_research: fairness note: dynamic tranche should allow per-tenant priority and also an opt-in flag for latency-sensitive routes to opt-out of tranche burns.

paul_sales: marketability: call it "Staged Commit — Burst Tranches". Emphasize lower cost vs pure on-demand and clearer rollovers.

dina_ops: telemetry list I'll add to backlog: tranche_consumed_tokens, tranche_preempt_events, tranche_unlock_events, tranche_cooldowns, tranche_latency_delta, global_tranche_disable_events.

marta_pm: action items: @leo_eng draft API + router admission semantics; @dina_ops list runbook alerts + dashboards; @paul_sales prepare pilot packaging + example pricing; @anya_research craft eval scenarios; I'll draft spec doc and scheduling plan. Target: pilot shortlist for Q3 pilot bucket.

kevin_sre: one more: consider circuit breaker that backs off tranche unlock aggressiveness during infra maintenance windows.

marta_pm: thanks — I'll post a proto spec and a short spreadsheet with pricing examples by EOD.

leo_eng: will start a proto branch and ping infra for perf baseline.

paul_sales: I'll loop in customer success for pilot candidates.

anya_research: creating eval ticket now.

dina_ops: ack, adding dashboard skeleton to observability backlog.
